logp.method_description: The log Po/w values of all the carbonate and carboxylate complexes were measured by using a shake-flask method. The presaturated PBS and octanol utilized here were prepared by mixing the two-phase solution and then shaking at room temperature overnight. A portion of 0.5 mL of pre-saturated PBS buffer containing 50 μM Pt(IV) complex was incubated with the pre-saturated octanol (0.5 mL) in a 2 mL tube. The tube containing the two-phase mixtures was shaken at room temperature for 1 h. The two-phase mixtures were isolated by centrifugation and the platinum content in each phase was determined by ICP-OES. The results of log Po/w were expressed as a mean of three independent measurements.
